name: 表示チャンネルを選ぶ案内
prompt:
Recreate the Japanese Discord channel-choice onboarding card shown in the primary native preview. Match its 390x284 canvas proportion and component geometry closely. This is a faithful reconstruction of the native Japanese component, not a redesign.

Keep the canvas white. Place one pale mint rounded rectangle about x30 y8, 330x262, with a corner radius near 10, centered horizontally. Keep the small gray close X near the card upper-right at x343 y28. Above the title, keep a white rounded illustration window around x80 y20 through x310 y151, with the compact dark charcoal channel-list graphic centered within it. The graphic has four rows: row 1 white # and white line with a small green heart; row 2 muted gray # and line; row 3 very dim # and dark line with a red X and faint radial ticks at the right; row 4 muted gray # and line. Preserve the compact original illustration and white side margin.

Render the exact Japanese title centered and bold: 「表示するチャンネルを選ぶ」. Below it, center these exact three lines in small dark-green Japanese text with the native line spacing: 「関心のある会話だけを一覧に表示できます。」 / 「自分へのメンションがある会話は、」 / 「非表示にしていても一覧に表示されます。」. Do not paraphrase or add copy. Match the native hierarchy, positions and modest text size.

No hyperlink text appears in the Japanese native component. Preserve the title and explanatory copy in their native dark colors. If any hyperlink label is visible, render that linked text blue so it is recognizable as a hyperlink. The original English screenshot’s blue BETA badge is a status badge rather than a hyperlink and is not part of this Japanese card.

Exclude the phone status bar, app header, tabs, search field, channel list, bottom Discord/Mobbin footer, and all other screen chrome. Do not add a button, a badge, avatar, shadow-heavy material, extra icon, or extra text. Use the first reference as authority for Japanese wording, native styling and component positioning; use the original source only for channel illustration details.
reviewNotes: v001を実画像で目視。正確な日本語見出し・3行の説明・チャンネル図形・灰色の閉じるXを保持。リンク文言なし。nativeは390x284。生成版はカードがキャンバスに対して小さく、上左右の余白が大きい。図と見出しの縦位置・比率にも差が残るため1回目を修正対象にする。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
